scope: F2 fold-0 screen. The missing mechanism from P20-FEAT57-LOWRANK-INTERACTIONS: a SUPERVISED low-rank pairwise interaction model trained with satisfaction labels. Factorized logistic on rating pairs (u_i * v_j) with cross-fitting.

H57_SUPERVISED_LOWRANK.question: Does a SUPERVISED low-rank factorization of the 13 rating pairs (trained with satisfaction labels via cross-fitting) improve fold-0 OOF AUC when added to 21raw?
H57_SUPERVISED_LOWRANK.method: Factorized logistic on rating pairs: logit = w·x + Σ_{r=1..8} (u_r·x_ratings)(v_r·x_ratings). Cross-fit 5-fold: train factorization on folds 1-4 with satisfaction labels, predict 8-dim embeddings for fold-0. Add 8 embeddings to 21raw. LGBM fold-0.
H57_SUPERVISED_LOWRANK.leakage: Factorization trained on FIT only (folds 1-4) with satisfaction labels. Predict fold-0 embeddings. Fold-safe.
H57_SUPERVISED_LOWRANK.decision_rule: PROMISING if fold-0 port_delta >= +5e-5 AND corr_vs_portfolio < 0.995.
